purpose: Spec for the UI agent: re-encode photos the server refuses with 415 code 'convert_on_client' (WebP, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF) to JPEG on the device, which also drops EXIF/XMP, then upload the JPEG to POST /api/v1/civic/issues/media.

helper.name: reencodeToJpeg
helper.signature: reencodeToJpeg(file: File | Blob, opts?: { maxSide?: number; quality?: number; maxBytes?: number }): Promise<Blob>
steps: Always run it for any file whose type or magic bytes are not JPEG/PNG, and optionally for every photo (it strips metadata for free).

Decode with createImageBitmap(file, { imageOrientation: 'from-image' }) so the EXIF orientation is applied before the metadata is discarded. Fall back to an HTMLImageElement + object URL where createImageBitmap rejects the format.

Scale so the longer side is <= maxSide (never upscale), draw onto an OffscreenCanvas or <canvas> (fill white first so transparent pixels do not turn black), then canvas.toBlob('image/jpeg', quality) / convertToBlob.
If the blob is larger than maxBytes lower quality by 0.1 (floor 0.5) and retry; then lower maxSide by 25% and retry. Give up after 5 attempts and show 'photo too large'.
Canvas output carries no EXIF, XMP or GPS. Never read or send the original file after this point.

HEIC: Safari and Chrome on recent iOS/Android decode it natively through createImageBitmap. Where decode fails (older desktop Chrome/Firefox) show 'This photo format is not supported here, choose a JPEG or take a new photo' and do NOT bundle a WASM HEIC decoder without a licence review.
Upload the resulting Blob as the raw request body with Content-Type: image/jpeg.

errors_to_handle.415 convert_on_client: run the helper once and retry the upload automatically; do not loop
errors_to_handle.422 scan_rejected: show 'this file was rejected'; do not retry

gps_note: Photos are not used for location. The report form sends lat/lon separately; the server keeps the exact point encrypted and internal and shows only a ~100 m rounded point publicly.
